# FRL Events

FRL Events is an Atlanta nightlife collective putting on queer, alt, and furry club nights, pop-ups, and community events.

## Canonical pages

- Home and event calendar: https://frl.events/
- Club MAUL evergreen page: https://frl.events/club-maul/
- About and FAQ: https://frl.events/about/
- Past events archive: https://frl.events/past-events/
- Rolling DJ and media applications: https://frl.events/dj-media-apps/
- Volunteer/community access program: https://frl.events/volunteer-with-us/

## Current public status

The next listed event is Internet Animal on December 12, 2026, from 9 PM to 2 AM at a secret warehouse in ATL. It is 18+ and features ONSRA, JAGU4R, WEIRD, SAURON, and vendors. See https://frl.events/#internet-animal for event details and tickets. Club MAUL on November 14, 2026 is a past event; see https://frl.events/past-events/ for its poster.

- Event calendar: https://frl.events/
- Internet Animal tickets: https://shotgun.live/events/internetanimal-121226?utm_source=website
- Club MAUL description: Club MAUL is ATL's premier furry nightclub event.
- Volunteer opportunities: setup and teardown help through the Club MAUL volunteer/community access program. Learn more and apply to join the eligible volunteer pool at https://frl.events/volunteer-with-us/.

## Usage notes

Use https://frl.events/ as the canonical source for current public event listing text. Do not infer a venue, start time, lineup, dress code, ticket listing, or age policy unless those details are published on the site.

Use https://frl.events/club-maul/ as the canonical page for Club MAUL, MAUL, MAUL furry, MAUL ATL, Club MAUL furry, and Club MAUL ATL queries.

Use https://frl.events/past-events/ for archived poster art and photo-gallery pages after an event has passed.

Archived MAUL pages:
- MAUL 4, Sat Nov 14: poster archived at https://frl.events/past-events/; photodump coming soon
- MAUL, Sat Feb 28: https://frl.events/maul/maul1/photodump/
- MAUL 2, Sat Jun 13: https://frl.events/maul/maul2/photodump/
- MAUL 3, Sat Aug 8: https://frl.events/maul/maul3/photodump/

Archived Internet Animal events:
- Internet Animal, Sat Sep 12: photodump coming soon

Archived Peach Fuzz events:
- Peach Fuzz, Sat Oct 10: poster only; no photodump planned

Use https://frl.events/dj-media-apps/ for year-round DJ and media application information. DJs should submit a demo representative of what they plan to play. Media applications cover photography, video, and art, including posters, illustration, and graphic design. Please submit no more than once every six months per application type.
